timecoded_text_to_speech.text: What's up family?
Logan hip-hop Atlanta star Alexis Sky was recently on IG Live with Jason Lee of Hollywood Unlocked, addressing the hate that she receives daily from people
who talk down to her about her special needs daughter.
Family, this is the ugly side of fame or should I say life.
There are some wicked people in the world and if there's a hell they're all gonna go.
She said that she really don't let the internet bother her.
It used to but she learned to set up barriers and block it out.
She said her daughter has hydrocephalus, a condition in which fluid accumulates in the brain, typically in young children enlarging the head and sometimes causing brain damage.
Who would attack an innocent kid like that?
This kid is two years old.
Don't even know what's going on in the world and people are attacking this kid every day.
Jason said that he has a sister who has a special needs kid.
He has autism and so he knows how difficult it is for Alexis every day.
Imagine this family, imagine you having a hardship like that.
But you're doing your best.
This woman doves over this girl.
I see a lot of her post and I don't even follow her.
She's in a news so I see a lot of steps in the news but she's always posting about her daughter on IG.
She posts its pictures of her and her daughter all the time.
She seems to have embraced the road.
She's not trying to hide her daughter.
I know some of you are saying, well you don't want your daughter being seen.
You don't want nobody to say nothing about her.
Don't post her.
I get it but at the same time.
Are we really that man?
Yes we are that but damn.
How did we become so devoid of feelings?
I know people who have children with special needs and I'm telling you.
I don't know how to do it.
They're heroes in my book.
I mean they put in work and those kids mostly work their last nerves.
They got to still go out and do what everybody else do.
You still got to go out and work.
You still have to be social or try to have some type of social life.
You still have to try to be sane and talk to people with courtesy and respect when your world is falling apart.
It's not easy.
But in, you got to deal with people who don't even know you.
Talking down?
Not cool.
Not cool at all.
Haven't said that.
I think we all know how bad it is out there.
There are some very wicked evil people in the world.
Just low down, dirty, lifeless people.
The world would have been better without them in it.
But here we are.
And if you post your child all over social media like Alexis does, especially if your child is considered different by societal norms,
you got to be prepared for the comments from the slow pokes.
If you wanted those slow pokes I'm talking about, your mama should be embarrassed and your daddy should have pulled out.
No more talk.
